dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: The glow of the Xiao Lanterns feels so warm...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: And I don't know if it's because of the music festival performance, but the stage lights made the lantern even brighter.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: This blazing heat ignites a nostalgic flame in me...
